svg.aria-label: One complaint line through translation, with its redaction kept as a break
svg.title: One complaint line through translation, with its redaction kept as a break
svg.text: What happens to a single sentence, and to its XXXX.
I went to get gas for my car.
I went to get gas for my car.
each part is translated on its own; the gap becomes x, the scholarly mark for a broken sign
what the machine says it wrote
“I have come to the bed of my chariot.”
The modern details fall away; the exasperation stays. The redaction travels through every step as a break in the clay.
Complaint 3396272 (Checking or savings account, received 2019-10-04), from data/translations.csv.
